content:
A hilly road.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ7.1.

photos.alt: A photo of a road swirling uphill from side to side, with a very small figure of a bicyclist riding on it. The front of the frame is covered by tall grass with yellow and purple flowers. Aside from the bicyclist, the road is empty and has bright white markings. Alongside the road, there are some power lines visible. To the left of the hill, there are other distant hills on the horizon. The sky is mostly blue, going a bit darker and hazier closer to the further hills.
